image.alt: A magnificent stag stands staring straight towards the camera on a path in the forest
image.caption: A red deer in the Hoge Veluwe national park.

items.title: A moment that changed me: I was always a pushover – until I stood up to some teenagers
items.trail: On the eve of my 40th birthday, I was doused with cold water at a train station. Before, I would have shrugged it off. But suddenly I realised it was time to assert myself

image.alt: A woman with a blue dress smiles while standing up holding her phone in a restaurant
image.caption: ‘Historically, my kneejerk reaction to being wronged would have been to pretend that I hadn’t been rattled’ … Ellie Violet Bramley on her 40th birthday.

items.title: TV tonight: five sisters fight for justice after a shocking murder in Belfast

image.alt: A smart middle-aged woman with brown hair sitting at a kitchen table

items.title: The shocking rise of rib remodelling: ‘I wanted that hourglass shape’
items.trail: It involves the fracturing of a patient’s ribs, before they spend three months laced into a corset. Some of those who have had this cosmetic procedure say it is like being ‘hit by a bus’. Why is it becoming more popular?

image.alt: A colourful composite image of a woman's waist.

items.trail: Oozing panache and bagging awards already, La Bola Negra is an eye-popping war and prejudice epic starring Penélope Cruz in a blond wig and Glenn Close speaking Spanish. We meet the ex-lovers who dreamed it up
